services.desc: Please note: Fields will open March 17, 2025.2025 Field rentals will be available to reserve starting January 2, 2025. Tower Grove Park is thriving with both youth and adult sports teams throughout the year. As early as March 17 through the beginning of November, teams are playing kickball, softball, baseball, ultimate frisbee, soccer and football throughout the park on any given day. Fields must be reserved at least 7 days in advance. Tower Grove Park has two sets of horseshoe pits that are located next to The Stupp Center. They are available on a first come, first served basis. services.name: Carriage Rides
services.desc: Meet at the stables, located at 4377 Northwest Dr., across from the tennis center. The carriage will not operate on days where the temperature is 93 degrees or above, or where the temperature is 15 degrees or below. Carriage will also not operate if snow, ice, heavy rain, or other conditions makes footing unsafe for the horse. Note: When making a reservation, please select the time you would like to begin the carriage ride. Reservations are available up to 90 days in the future.
